t: A kit for building a self-driving car and coding it from a phone or tablet.
steps: Find the kit on the Twin Science site or a retailer and confirm the price.
Check that the app works on a school phone or tablet.
Build the car from the kit.
Pair the coding module with the Twin Code Lab app by Bluetooth.
Write a short program to drive the car.
Test the line tracking and sensors.
Review the app privacy details before students use it.
